title: CADD-Base-7B: Apple’s Masked Diffusion Model for Code Generation
summary: A 7B parameter code generation model by Apple that utilizes Continuously Augmented Discrete Diffusion (CADD) for categorical generative modeling. It enhances standard masked diffusion by adding a continuous flow-matching signal in the embedding space to improve token prediction accuracy.
research_notes: Built upon the Qwen2.5-Coder-7B architecture; the CADD approach is designed to be orthogonal and integrable into other masked diffusion frameworks.

evolution.summary: Presented at ICLR 2026, the project evolved from Apple's previous DiffuCoder research. The official ml-cadd repository and model checkpoints were released in late April 2026, marking its transition to a stable, reproducible research platform.
